Method and limits Measured cell: at least 3 Ookla tests; usable speed 10 Mbps. Lit: night-light radiance above 0.33 (provisional; product and year are not stated in the source record). Assessable LGA: at least 3 measured cells; other LGAs are classed by lights only. Tier 1 = not 'Connected' and in the poorest third by RWI; core = Tier 1 under all 243 threshold settings tested. Exposed people = people in unlit cells with no usable or a slow speed measurement. Unmeasured is not unserved. Lit cells hold 30% of people, against about 62% national access reported in the source study, so 'dark' means no detectable light. Class names describe measured cells only: an assessable LGA can have under 10% of its people measured. Results show association, not causation.

Sources: Ookla Open Data (provided folder; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 per Ookla's repository); Meta Relative Wealth Index (CC BY-NC 4.0, Chi et al. 2022); OnSSET data package, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15265285 (CC BY 4.0): population raster, night lights, GADM boundaries, GRID3 facilities; HV lines: Nigeria SE4ALL portal.
